name: portal-frame
comment: BlockPortal without fire: two obsidian frames (inside 2 wide, 3 high; one along x, one along z) filled silently with portal blocks (id 90; fill does not notify, so the partial frames never see each other). A cobblestone item inside the first portal falls through it (getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool is null; onEntityCollidedWithBlock calls Entity.setInPortal, empty for an item) onto the bottom obsidian. t=20 removes a side obsidian of the first frame and t=22 a bottom obsidian of the second: onNeighborBlockChange removes the portal blocks one by one through the notifications. t=24 sets a lone portal block on the platform, which stays (no neighbour changes). block_box, entity state, rng_state.
